dialogue.description: You answer in character, in the current language, in one spoken sentence.

trust_percent.description: You give your current absolute trust, 0-100, reflecting this exchange.

emotion.description: You choose the feeling you express.

completed_objectives.description: You list the exact progress_ids earned by the player's words and your reply, each once. Check all supplied criteria; prerequisites must already be met. Use the one matching ID for an agreed amount, or [] when nothing is earned.

comedy.description: You rate only the latest player_dialogue and your current reply as one comedic exchange from 0 (not funny) to 1 (exceptionally funny for an Adult Swim show). Judge absurdity, timing, surprise and banter, not profanity alone; use 0 for openings and game events without player speech. Put comedy last.
